format.wav.label.description: The WAV chip of the Format row.

format.wav.title.description: Tooltip of the WAV format chip.

format.made.description: Tooltip of the selected format chip when its codec is not the default: what the file is made of. {codec} is a codec name (HEVC, CineForm…).

row.codec.description: Label of the Codec row of the export settings.

codec.h264.title.description: Tooltip of the H.264 codec chip.

codec.hevc.title.description: Tooltip of the HEVC codec chip.

codec.av1.title.description: Tooltip of the AV1 codec chip.

codec.vp9.title.description: Tooltip of the VP9 codec chip.

codec.cineform.label.description: Codec chip; "CineForm" is GoPro's name and stays as it is.

codec.cineform.title.description: Tooltip of the CineForm codec chip.

codec.animation.title.description: Tooltip of the Lossless codec chip.

codec.prores422.label.description: Codec chip (shown only if the owner turns ProRes on).

codec.prores4444.label.description: Codec chip (shown only if the owner turns ProRes on).

hevc.probing.description: Tooltip of the HEVC chip while Flown looks for an HEVC encoder on the graphics card.

export.checking.description: The Export button, and a status for screen readers, while an export waits for Flown to finish looking for an HEVC encoder on the graphics card (a few seconds) before the save dialog opens.

notice.cannotMake.description: Under the Codec row when stored settings ask for a codec this PC cannot make. {codec} and {fallback} are codec names.

hint.hevcGpu.description: Hint under the Codec row. {names} lists encoders: "NVENC, QSV".

hint.av1Gpu.description: Hint under the Codec row. {names} lists encoders: "NVENC, QSV".

hint.av1Cpu.description: Hint under the Codec row when no graphics card makes AV1. {time} is a duration ("4 min").

hint.cineform.description: Hint under the Codec row for CineForm. {size} is a file size, {length} the video length.

hint.animation.description: Hint under the Codec row for Lossless.

hint.prores.description: Hint under the Codec row for ProRes.

fps.no4k120.description: Under the Frame rate row, why 120 fps is disabled.

fps.4kAt60.description: Hint after picking 4K while H.264 was at 120 fps.

quality.best.description: Quality chip of the editing formats.

quality.high.description: Quality chip of the editing formats.

quality.medium.description: Quality chip of the editing formats.

quality.cineform.film1.description: Tooltip of the Best chip with CineForm.

quality.cineform.high.description: Tooltip of the High chip with CineForm.

quality.cineform.medium.description: Tooltip of the Medium chip with CineForm.

quality.prores.hq.description: Tooltip of the Best chip with ProRes 422.

quality.prores.standard.description: Tooltip of the High chip with ProRes 422.

quality.prores.lt.description: Tooltip of the Medium chip with ProRes 422.

target.editing.description: Why Target size is disabled for the editing formats.

target.wav.description: Why Target size is disabled for WAV.

sizeLine.withCodec.description: The size line under the preview with a codec other than the default: "1080×1350 · 30 fps · HEVC · 2:14".
